children: Cardano is now live in the official x402 SDK, letting applications and AI agents pay for API calls in ADA or any Cardano native token over a single web request. The deployment covers the client, server, facilitator, and Masumi transfer method, so the full payment flow runs natively over HTTP without custom settlement layers.

The x402 standard revives HTTP 402 payments for machine-to-machine commerce, and Cardano's inclusion means agents can settle per-request charges in ADA or CNTs directly. This gives the token a utility path tied to agentic payments, a rail that major payment and cloud players have been building around. Practical effect depends on developer uptake: apps must integrate the SDK and route demand through facilitators before ADA payment volume becomes measurable. Until then, the change is an infrastructure capability rather than proven transaction flow.
